decision.main: L-F, a falsifiable integrated mechanism: abstract free-slot capacity reservation + actual normal source READ + destination binding before first WRITE AW, with event-maintained resident/free metadata.
decision.bounded_alternative: L-I: reuse the same event-maintained index at the existing pre-firstVALID selection point, avoiding the symbolic backend contract if its complete cost loses to ordinary source preparation. This is an implementation variant of L, not a third independent research direction.
decision.inherited_backup: R remains the round02 relation-compression backup; no new R benefit asserted. T remains low priority because native one-cycle continuation does not support its presumed gap.
decision.not_promoted: Joint matching, bare hot-first, current-victim prediction, slot credits and software generation relocation are not independent algorithm claims.
decision.innovation_gate: If a legal ownership-changing interval and actual paid pipeline make L-F improve the V/A frontier or full implementation cost over source prepare, current-victim/pin, software/locality and equal-resource capacity controls, and the exact nearest published mechanism does not cover that integration, it can form an independent mechanism contribution. If those controls match at equal/lower complete cost, stop that benefit claim or use L-I.

comparison_identity_boundary: An ordinary hardware hot-first allocator with the identical full proposed event-index and late parent is an equivalent implementation of L-F, not evidence that a published predecessor covered it and not a separate competitor the proposal must somehow beat. Use ordinary same-parent page-local/LIFO as ablation and independently executable source-prepare/victim/pin/layout/capacity as controls; charge all information interfaces equally. Actual low-cost controls that use a shared proposed component can identify which remaining component adds no value, without automatically erasing the whole integration claim.
downstream_order: Parallel design gates F1(real trace),F5(contract),F6(full costs); once a coherent legal case exists, downstream only runs the decisive small F2 model, then F3/F4 as needed. Do not build a large matrix or require universal superiority before a bounded model.
